verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents the pymilvus Python SDK, Milvus Lite and an official MCP server, but nothing about an official Milvus command-line tool. An SDK is a developer building block and the MCP server belongs to a separate story, so neither earns credit here. A CLI is a fair axis for a vector database, so absence of evidence is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
